description: Find open research datasets you may use, each with a plain licence verdict (public domain, attribution, share-alike, no-derivatives, non-commercial, not stated) read from Zenodo's structured licence, plus DOI, authors and file links. Default: only commercially usable ones. A search with nothing usable is refused before payment. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

q.description: what data you need, in plain words
